entries.what: Marcus finishes Sunday night's shift at Ridgeline RF-4 and picks up a power bank at the break room vending kiosk after his phone dies at 4 a.m. again. He eats eggs and rice at Marisol Gardens unit 132 and crashes by 8.
entries.outcome: Starts carrying the power bank on shift from now on.

entries.what: Wakes at 1 p.m., grabs a bag and heads to his 2 p.m. afternoon section at Bayshore State, taking the Tule Line.
entries.outcome: Makes class, fighting sleepiness through the lecture.

entries.what: Bikes to Ridgeline for the 10 p.m. shift on the general pick floor with Trevor nearby.
After shift at 7 a.m., Marcus asks his assistant for a workable sleep schedule, adding that he doesn't want the 8-hours lecture. He eats eggs and rice and sleeps 8 to 1.
entries.outcome: Gets a rough schedule he will tweak himself.

entries.what: Free Tuesday afternoon: he does laundry, studies Fatima's shared Google Doc notes for Ex Phys, and chats with roommate Arjun in the kitchen.
Bikes to Ridgeline for the night shift; the rear brake squeaks the whole ride.
Gets off shift, then sleeps a short night's day, waking at 1 p.m. for tutoring-free Wednesday; he heads to campus for his 2 p.m. section.
Texts Jade between classes about weekend plans, and she says she wishes he were awake more on her days off.
entries.outcome: They leave it unresolved until Friday.

entries.what: Evening: Marcus eats a prepped meal and rides to Ridgeline for the shift, listening to West Coast rap in one earbud.
Home at 7 a.m., eats, and sleeps. Wakes at 1 p.m. and rides the Tule Line to his Thursday section.
After class he has a quick gym-less afternoon, calls his mom Denise to check in about her cut hours.
entries.outcome: She insists she is fine; he worries quietly.

entries.what: Last night shift of the work week: Carla reminds the crew about rate on the breakroom board and Jose posts assignments at 9:40.
Marcus misses Jade's day off by sleeping through it after the shift, and asks his assistant for a funny text to send her.
entries.outcome: Sends a joke text; she replies with a half-laugh.

entries.what: Payday Friday: he checks his Ridgeline deposit, pays attention to groceries and bills, and picks up a Taquería Colima burrito on Calle Ortega.
Lifts at Iron Flats Fitness with Mike on the 5/3/1 program before heading home.
Marcus sees the Ridgeline hiring fair crowd on Ruel Road as he leaves shift; Aaliyah Simmons is among the people lined up for seasonal work.
entries.outcome: He nods hello and keeps going home.

entries.what: Sleeps through the morning, then does a lazy afternoon at the apartment, cleaning his sneakers.
Saturday evening with Jade at Phở Bến Thành, making up for the missed day off.
entries.outcome: Good night; she says she appreciates the effort.

entries.what: Sunday afternoon: Marcus does his chicken-and-rice meal prep, five containers, in the unit 132 kitchen.
Checks his phone and sees Keisha, now AFUSD dispatch, is no longer driving buses, per Rochelle's family chatter online; he mostly scrolls sneaker news.
Bikes to Ridgeline for the Sunday night shift, power bank in his pocket.
